lexical_policy: Retain the generated category in slot0. Replace each valid attribute slot1..4 by the frozen CLIP empty-string vector. Preserve slot count, mask, padding, initialization key and all other tensors.
selection_provenance: M67 uses the category-only lexical policy during both paired training and inference, following M65. Both M67 heads are newly trained from zero residual initialization. This is not deployment-only removal of attributes from the M58 full-attribute head.
